description: A small black USB hub with several ports sits on a green bedspread, with a cable leading toward a purple pillow under a bunk frame. The left hand moves in from the lower left to steady the hub as a left-hand object, while the right hand comes in from the lower right, grasps the USB plug as a right-hand object, pulls it straight out of the hub, and then releases it so the connector rests on the bed.
